classification: post-hoc defensive-bucket selection rule using cached frozen R344 equity sleeves

defensive_rule.selection: Hold the top two ETFs at 50% each after the signal; the signal applies only to subsequent returns.
defensive_rule.signal: At each monthly rebalance, rank the three ETFs by total return over the trailing 60 trading days through the signal close.

hypothesis: Replacing the fixed one-third defensive bucket with a monthly 60-day dual-momentum top-two rule reduces equity-correlated drawdown and improves recent-year and 2022 experience without changing the frozen A/B equity sleeves, C sleeve, 10% satellite cap, 1/3 equity-risk share, 15% volatility target or leverage constraint.
limits: R349 is post-hoc after observing R344-R348 results and is not an independent out-of-sample discovery.
The common window begins in 2022 because TTM data for the C sleeve begins then.
ETF qfq caches are not official PIT total-return series and do not model premium/discount.
The rule is evaluated on current reconstructed HS300 membership and current-snapshot industry classification.
Top-two momentum can whipsaw around month boundaries despite the 50% turnover cap.
The runner depends on the frozen R344 cache; exact baseline reconstruction is required before candidate evaluation.
